text:
maria: Heads up — proposing a small RBAC tweak for SIEM exports: timeboxed 'audit copy' flow for vuln triage. Starting this thread to collect objections.

tyler: TL;DR of the change? what perms are we touching?

maria: Add a scoped role (export:request) for analysts that creates timeboxed export tokens. Requirements: JIT approval, default TTL = 24h, escalation path to 72h with secops sign-off, KMS unwrap only via secops service account, and a mandatory justification field in the request ticket.

naveen: 24h default sounds reasonable. 72h only with explicit secops review — otherwise too much blast radius.

maria: Agreed. Implementation idea: default TTL 24h, UI dropdown for 24 / 48 / 72 but 48/72 require an approval checkbox + secops approver. Also emit an audit event whenever a token triggers a CMK unwrap.

sara: We'll need a short oncall playbook: how to rewrap/rotate CMK and how to revoke exports fast if suspected leak. Also update console to display 'export owner', 'justification', and 'TTL remaining'.

secops-bot: Playbook draft live: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ephemeral-export. Quick revoke command included:

```
secopsctl revoke-export --token <token-id>
```

tyler: :eyes: Can we enforce PII masking on self-serve exports? Full raw should be allowed only through secops-forensics workflow.

naveen: Masking for every export will increase job cost. Suggest: self-serve = sampled + masked; full raw = secops ticket + CMK unwrap + explicit RBAC grant. Also add a KMS-unwrap column into SIEM exports so we can easily filter by unwrap events.

maria: Action items from this thread:
1) Default TTL = 24h, 2) Escalation to 72h requires secops approval, 3) Ticket must include justification + checklist, 4) Emit audit events for KMS unwraps and surface in SIEM, 5) Update runbook + console UI to show owner/TTL/justification. I'll open PRs for RBAC and a runbook update.

sara: I can own the runbook edits — will add the CMK rotation steps and quick revocation commands.

tyler: I'll prototype the UI flag and TTL dropdown; will add the 'request escalation' checkbox. ETA: EOW.

maria: Thanks all — filing ticket and linking this thread. :thumbsup:

secops-bot: Ticket created: https://redwood.internal/SEC-4521 assigned to maria. Reminder: runbook review due in 3 days.
